content: Failing test at tooling/tests/test_doc_drift_critic.py::test_c2_wrong_shape_route_table_is_exit_3_not_traceback demonstrates divergence (DOC_DRIFT_DIVERGENCE=1). route = 5 or route = ["a"] parses as TOML, then load_doc_files raises TypeError/AttributeError -> unhandled traceback, Python exit 1 — REQ-9's DRIFT-FOUND class, so a broken route table is misreported as a drift finding, and the 'never a traceback' contract (REQ-9/AC-5 discipline, restated in the gate's own docstring) is broken. Expected: exit 3, no Traceback. Toolchain site: def load_doc_files in tooling/doc-drift.py (shape of data['route'] never validated).
